caption:
Two days back at the desk and Mr Turtle's neck is already grumbling.

Over the break, most people move more and sit still less. Going straight back to eight-hour screen days asks a lot, so some stiffness in week one is common and usually settles.

Ease in: move every 30 minutes for the first week with head turns, chin tucks and shoulder rolls. Raise your laptop so your eyes sit level with the top of the screen, and keep a shorter version of that holiday walk or swim going.

Pain into the arm, pins and needles, hand weakness or building headaches are worth getting checked. Our Sydney CBD and Chatswood physios can help. Book online via the link in bio 🐢
